name: Ravooka Platform
author: ravooka

sections.description:
Ravooka Platform is a lightweight and flexible WordPress plugin designed to help publishers seamlessly integrate and manage ads across their content.

With built-in support for Gutenberg blocks and dynamic rendering, Ravooka Platform allows you to control how and where ads appear—without modifying your theme.

🔑 Key Features

  • Dynamic Ad Injection
    Automatically render ads above featured images and within content.

  • Multiple Ad Formats
    Supports Featured (Composite), Carousel, Leaderboard, and Press-Unifier ads.

  • Custom Block Ordering
    Configure the display order of ad blocks directly from the settings panel.

  • Per-Post Control
    Override ad configurations (Prod IDs) on individual posts.

  • Gutenberg Integration
    Includes reusable block patterns for easy ad placement.

  • Optimized Delivery
    Loads ads efficiently using Ravooka’s ad engine.

  • Dynamic PR Injection

Automatically render press release.

Ravooka Platform is ideal for publishers who want better control over monetization without sacrificing performance or layout flexibility.

Learn more at: https://www.ravooka.ai

External services

This plugin connects to an external service provided by Ravooka to display advertisements.

Service: Ravooka Ads
Purpose: To load and display advertisement units within posts and blocks.

What data is sent:
– Publisher ID (entered in plugin settings)
– Ad slot identifiers
– Page URL and basic page context
– Visitor IP address
– Approximate geographic location (derived from IP, may include country, region, or coordinates)
– Device and browser information (user agent)

When data is sent:
– When a page containing Ravooka ad units is loaded
– When the Ravooka ad script is executed in the visitor’s browser

Cookies:
– This service does NOT use cookies for tracking

Service provider:
Ravooka

Terms of Service:
https://ravooka.ai/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://ravooka.ai/privacy

Additional Notes

For support or inquiries, visit:
https://www.ravooka.ai
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ravooka directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Ravooka Platform and enter your Publisher ID.
  4. Configure other settings and you are good to go.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Ravooka account?

Yes. You need a valid Ravooka Publisher ID to serve ads.

Can I control ad placement?

Yes. You can control placement globally, including block order and product IDs.

Will this work with any theme?

Yes. The plugin works independently of your theme and does not require theme modifications.

Does this support Gutenberg blocks?

Yes. Ravooka Platform provides block patterns for easy integration within the Gutenberg editor.
